description: Estimate a quote from a scope description. Returns deterministic 'historical' and 'rate-card' variants (each with sum and confidence) plus the context (comparable past projects, standard rate). Add your own 'free-scope' variant from the context, then present all variants with totals so the user can pick.

billingClientId.description: Client the quote is for (biases comparables)

billingEntityId.description: Sender entity (defaults to the user default)

projectId.description: Anchor project to prioritise as a comparable

scope.description: Free-text description of the work to quote

name: estimate_quote
title: Estimate quote
